Tier 0 · Operation data
Saves progress and runs the lesson. Never reused for research.
Who sees it: the school, and the studio as its processor.
Event catalogue: every event declared with its purpose
Tier 1 · Event data, OGD format with the child-safe profile
Random player codes per product, declared fields only, no free text, device class only.
Who sees it: the controller and its processors. Never public.
Study build for classes that agreed,
with agreement and ethics approval
At least 10 players and
3 classes per figure
Tier 2 · Research extracts
Relative time; the studio keeps the key.
Who sees it: named researchers
under the research agreement.
Tier 3 · Open evidence feed
Group figures per level: time, stuck,
help, gain, access, natural stops.
Who sees it: everyone, CC0 licence.
check-feed: hashes, profile, thresholds
Catalogues and the Play to Learn Toolkit
Play data panel, evidence items,
lesson plan tips, research commons.
